     disjoint styp_nat (styp_arrow A1 A2)
 | D_axArrNat : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) styp_nat
 | D_axNatRcd : forall (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint styp_nat (styp_rcd l A)
 | D_axRcdNat : forall (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) styp_nat
 | D_axArrRcd : forall (A1 A2:styp) (l:i) (A:styp),
     disjoint (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_rcd l A)
 | D_axRcdArr : forall (l:i) (A A1 A2:styp),
     disjoint (styp_rcd l A) (styp_arrow A1 A2).

Inductive has_type : sctx -> sexp -> dirflag -> styp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | T_top : forall (GG:sctx),
      uniq  GG  ->
     has_type GG e_top Inf styp_top trm_unit
 | T_lit : forall (GG:sctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  GG  ->
     has_type GG (e_lit i5) Inf styp_nat (trm_lit i5)
 | T_var : forall (GG:sctx) (x:var) (A:styp),
      uniq  GG  ->
      binds  x A GG  ->
     has_type GG (e_var_f x) Inf A (trm_var_f x)
 | T_app : forall (GG:sctx) (ee1 ee2:sexp) (A2:styp) (e1 e2:exp) (A1:styp),
     has_type GG ee1 Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) e1 ->
     has_type GG ee2 Chk A1 e2 ->
     has_type GG (e_app ee1 ee2) Inf A2 (trm_app e1 e2)
 | T_merge : forall (GG:sctx) (ee1 ee2:sexp) (A1 A2:styp) (e1 e2:exp),
     has_type GG ee1 Inf A1 e1 ->
     has_type GG ee2 Inf A2 e2 ->
     disjoint A1 A2 ->
     has_type GG (e_merge ee1 ee2) Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (trm_pair e1 e2)
 | T_rcd : forall (GG:sctx) (l:i) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Inf A e ->
     has_type GG (e_rcd l ee) Inf (styp_rcd l A) (trm_rcd l e)
 | T_proj : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (l:i) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Inf (styp_rcd l A) e ->
     has_type GG (e_proj ee l) Inf A (trm_proj e l)
 | T_anno : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (e:exp),
     has_type GG ee Chk A e ->
     has_type GG (e_anno ee A) Inf A e
 | T_abs : forall (L:vars) (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A B:styp) (e:exp),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> has_type  (( x ~ A )++ GG )   ( open_sexp_wrt_sexp ee (e_var_f x) )  Chk B  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (trm_var_f x) )  )  ->
     has_type GG (e_abs ee) Chk (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs e)
 | T_sub : forall (GG:sctx) (ee:sexp) (A:styp) (c:co) (e:exp) (B:styp),
     has_type GG ee Inf B e ->
     sub B A c ->
     has_type GG ee Chk A (trm_capp c e).

Inductive CTyp : C -> sctx -> dirflag -> styp -> sctx -> dirflag -> styp -> cc -> Prop :=

 | CTyp_empty2 : forall (GG:sctx) (A:styp),

 | CTyp_appL1 : forall (C5:C) (ee2:sexp) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A2:styp) (cc5:cc) (e:exp) (A1:styp),
     CTyp C5 GG Inf A GG' Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) cc5 ->

 | CTyp_appL2 : forall (C5:C) (ee2:sexp) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A2:styp) (cc5:cc) (e:exp) (A1:styp),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf (styp_arrow A1 A2) cc5 ->
     has_type GG' ee2 Chk A1 e ->

 | CTyp_appR1 : forall (ee1:sexp) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A2:styp) (e:exp) (cc5:cc) (A1:styp),

     has_type GG' ee2 Inf A2 e ->

 | CTyp_mergeL2 : forall (C5:C) (ee2:sexp) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (cc5:cc) (e:exp),
     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf A1 cc5 ->
     has_type GG' ee2 Inf A2 e ->

     CTyp (C_MergeL C5 ee2) GG Chk A GG' Inf (styp_and A1 A2) (cc_PairL cc5 e)
 | CTyp_mergeR1 : forall (ee1:sexp) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (e:exp) (cc5:cc),

     CTyp C5 GG Chk A GG' Inf A2 cc5 ->

 | CTyp_rcd1 : forall (l:i) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (B:styp) (cc5:cc),

 | CTyp_anno2 : forall (C5:C) (A:styp) (GG:sctx) (B:styp) (GG':sctx) (cc5:cc),

     CTyp (C_Anno C5 A) GG Chk B GG' Inf A cc5
 | CTyp_abs1 : forall (x:var) (C5:C) (GG:sctx) (A:styp) (GG':sctx) (A1 A2:styp) (cc5:cc),

      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  GG' )  ->
     CTyp (C_Lam x C5) GG Inf A GG' Chk (styp_arrow A1 A2) (cc_Lam x cc5)

Inductive cotyp : co -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | cotyp_refl : forall (T:typ),
     cotyp co_id T T
 | cotyp_trans : forall (c1 c2:co) (T1 T3 T2:typ),
     cotyp c1 T2 T3 ->
     cotyp c2 T1 T2 ->
     cotyp (co_trans c1 c2) T1 T3
 | cotyp_top : forall (T:typ),
     cotyp co_top T a_unit
 | cotyp_topArr :
     cotyp co_topArr a_unit (a_arrow a_unit a_unit)
 | cotyp_arr : forall (c1 c2:co) (T1 T2 T1' T2':typ),
     cotyp c1 T1' T1 ->
     cotyp c2 T2 T2' ->
     cotyp (co_arr c1 c2) (a_arrow T1 T2) (a_arrow T1' T2')
 | cotyp_pair : forall (c1 c2:co) (T1 T2 T3:typ),
     cotyp c1 T1 T2 ->
     cotyp c2 T1 T3 ->
     cotyp (co_pair c1 c2) T1 (a_prod T2 T3)
 | cotyp_distArr : forall (T1 T2 T3:typ),
     cotyp co_distArr (a_prod  (a_arrow T1 T2)   (a_arrow T1 T3) ) (a_arrow T1 (a_prod T2 T3))
 | cotyp_projl : forall (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp co_proj1 (a_prod T1 T2) T1
 | cotyp_projr : forall (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp co_proj2 (a_prod T1 T2) T2
 | cotyp_rcd : forall (l:i) (c:co) (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp c T1 T2 ->
     cotyp (co_rcd l c) (a_rcd l T1) (a_rcd l T2)
 | cotyp_topRcd : forall (l:i),
     cotyp (co_topRcd l) a_unit (a_rcd l a_unit)
 | cotyp_distRcd : forall (l:i) (T1 T2:typ),
     cotyp (co_distRcd l) (a_prod (a_rcd l T1) (a_rcd l T2)) (a_rcd l (a_prod T1 T2)).

Inductive typing : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | typ_unit : forall (G:ctx),
      uniq  G  ->
     typing G trm_unit a_unit
 | typ_lit : forall (G:ctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  G  ->
     typing G (trm_lit i5) a_nat
 | typ_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
      binds  x T G  ->
     typing G (trm_var_f x) T
 | typ_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (e:exp) (T1 T2:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> typing  (( x ~ T1 )++ G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (trm_var_f x) )  T2 )  ->
     typing G (trm_abs e) (a_arrow T1 T2)
 | typ_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (T2 T1:typ),
     typing G e1 (a_arrow T1 T2) ->
     typing G e2 T1 ->
     typing G (trm_app e1 e2) T2
 | typ_pair : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (T1 T2:typ),
     typing G e1 T1 ->
     typing G e2 T2 ->
     typing G (trm_pair e1 e2) (a_prod T1 T2)
 | typ_capp : forall (G:ctx) (c:co) (e:exp) (T' T:typ),
     typing G e T ->
     cotyp c T T' ->
     typing G (trm_capp c e) T'
 | typ_rcd : forall (G:ctx) (l:i) (e:exp) (T:typ),
     typing G e T ->
     typing G (trm_rcd l e) (a_rcd l T)
 | typ_proj : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (l:i) (T:typ),
     typing G e (a_rcd l T) ->
     typing G (trm_proj e l) T.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | value_unit :
     value trm_unit
 | value_lit : forall (i5:i),
     value (trm_lit i5)
 | value_abs : forall (e:exp),
     lc_exp (trm_abs e) ->
     value (trm_abs e)
 | value_pair : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     value (trm_pair v1 v2)
 | value_rcd : forall (l:i) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_rcd l v)
 | value_cabs : forall (c1 c2:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_capp  ( (co_arr c1 c2) )  v)
 | value_cpair : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_capp co_distArr v)
 | value_topArr : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     value (trm_capp co_topArr v).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_id : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp co_id v) v
 | step_trans : forall (c1 c2:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp  ( (co_trans c1 c2) )  v) (trm_capp c1  ( (trm_capp c2 v) ) )
 | step_top : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp co_top v) trm_unit
 | step_topArr :
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_capp co_topArr trm_unit) )  trm_unit) trm_unit
 | step_arr : forall (c1 c2:co) (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_capp  ( (co_arr c1 c2) )  v1) )  v2) (trm_capp c2  ( (trm_app v1  ( (trm_capp c1 v2) ) ) ) )
 | step_pair : forall (c1 c2:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp (co_pair c1 c2) v) (trm_pair (trm_capp c1 v) (trm_capp c2 v))
 | step_distArr : forall (v1 v2 v3:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     value v3 ->
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_capp co_distArr (trm_pair v1 v2)) )  v3) (trm_pair (trm_app v1 v3) (trm_app v2 v3))
 | step_projl : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_capp co_proj1 (trm_pair v1 v2)) v1
 | step_projr : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_capp co_proj2 (trm_pair v1 v2)) v2
 | step_crcd : forall (l:i) (c:co) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_capp (co_rcd l c) (trm_rcd l v)) (trm_rcd l (trm_capp c v))
 | step_topRcd : forall (l:i),
     step (trm_capp (co_topRcd l) trm_unit) (trm_rcd l trm_unit)
 | step_distRcd : forall (l:i) (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     step (trm_capp (co_distRcd l) (trm_pair (trm_rcd l v1) (trm_rcd l v2))) (trm_rcd l (trm_pair v1 v2))
 | step_projRcd : forall (l:i) (v:exp),
     value v ->
     step (trm_proj (trm_rcd l v) l) v
 | step_beta : forall (e v:exp),
     lc_exp (trm_abs e) ->
     value v ->
     step (trm_app  ( (trm_abs e) )  v)  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e v )
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (trm_app e1 e2) (trm_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (trm_app v1 e2) (trm_app v1 e2')
 | step_pair1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (trm_pair e1 e2) (trm_pair e1' e2)
 | step_pair2 : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (trm_pair v1 e2) (trm_pair v1 e2')
 | step_capp : forall (c:co) (e e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (trm_capp c e) (trm_capp c e')
 | step_rcd1 : forall (l:i) (e e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (trm_rcd l e) (trm_rcd l e')
 | step_rcd2 : forall (e:exp) (l:i) (e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (trm_proj e l) (trm_proj e' l).

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : var) (e1 : exp) {struct e1} : exp :=
  match e1 with
    | trm_var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (trm_var_b n1) else (trm_var_f x2)
    | trm_var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (trm_var_b n2) else (trm_var_b (S n2))
    | trm_unit => trm_unit
    | trm_lit i1 => trm_lit i1
    | trm_abs e2 => trm_abs (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S n1) x1 e2)
    | trm_app e2 e3 => trm_app (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e2) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e3)
    | trm_pair e2 e3 => trm_pair (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e2) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec n1 x1 e3)

Lemma ne_star_map : forall (F : exp -> exp),
    (forall e f, step e f -> step (F e) (F f)) ->
    forall e f, e ->* f -> F e ->* F f.
Proof. intros F HF e f H; induction H; eauto with necolus. Qed.

Lemma ne_value_lc : forall v, value v -> lc_exp v.
Proof. induction 1; auto with necolus. Qed.

Lemma ne_value_irred : forall v, value v -> forall t, ~ step v t.
Proof. induction 1; intros t Hs; inversion Hs; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ne_step_det : forall e f, step e f -> forall g, step e g -> f = g.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros g Hg; inversion Hg; subst;
    try reflexivity;
    repeat match goal with
    | Hv : value ?v, Hs : step ?v _ |- _ =>
        exfalso; exact (ne_value_irred _ Hv _ Hs)
    | H : value (trm_pair _ _) |- _ => inversion H; clear H; subst
    | H : value (trm_rcd _ _) |- _ => inversion H; clear H; subst
    | H : value (trm_capp _ _) |- _ => inversion H; clear H; subst
    | H : value (trm_abs _) |- _ => clear H
    | H : step (trm_abs _) _ |- _ => inversion H
    | H : step trm_unit _ |- _ => inversion H
    end;
    try solve [f_equal; eauto];
    try solve [exfalso; eapply ne_value_irred; eauto 8 with necolus].
Qed.

Lemma ne_eval_unique : forall e v w,
    e ->* v -> e ->* w -> value v -> value w -> v = w.
Proof.
  intros e v w H; revert w.
  induction H; intros w Hw Hv Hwv; inversion Hw; subst; auto.
  - exfalso; eapply ne_value_irred; eauto.
  - exfalso; eapply ne_value_irred; eauto.
  - assert (b = b0) by (eapply ne_step_det; eauto). subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ne_app_steps : forall e f v w,
    lc_exp f -> value v -> e ->* v -> f ->* w ->
    trm_app e f ->* trm_app v w.
Proof.

  - apply (ne_star_map (fun t => trm_app t f)); eauto with necolus.
  - apply (ne_star_map (trm_app v)); eauto with necolus.

    trm_pair e f ->* trm_pair v w.

  match e1 with
    | trm_var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (trm_var_b n1) else (trm_var_f x2)

    | trm_unit => trm_unit
    | trm_lit i1 => trm_lit i1

Definition ne_related A B e f :=
  lc_exp e /\\ lc_exp f /\\
  exists v w, e ->* v /\\ f ->* w /\\ ne_good A v /\\ ne_good B w /\\ ne_rel A B v w.

Local Ltac ne_unpack :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : ne_related _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct H as (? & ? & ? & ? & ? & ? & ? & ? & ?)
  end.

Lemma ne_related_value : forall A B v w,
    ne_good A v -> ne_good B w -> ne_rel A B v w -> ne_related A B v w.
Proof. intros; repeat split; eauto with necolus; exists v, w; eauto with necolus. Qed.

Lemma ne_related_app : forall A B C D f g a b,
    ne_related (styp_arrow A B) (styp_arrow C D) f g ->
    ne_related A C a b ->
    ne_related B D (trm_app f a) (trm_app g b).
Proof.
  intros; ne_unpack.
  match goal with
  | HF : ne_good (styp_arrow A B) ?v,
    HG : ne_good (styp_arrow C D) ?w,
    Ha : ne_good A ?x, Hb : ne_good C ?y,
    Hr : ne_rel (styp_arrow A B) (styp_arrow C D) ?v ?w |- _ =>
      destruct HF as [Hv HF]; destruct HG as [Hw HG];
      destruct (HF _ Ha) as (r & Hstep_r & Hgr);
      destruct (HG _ Hb) as (s & Hstep_s & Hgs);
      assert (Hrs : ne_rel B D r s) by
        (eapply ne_eval2_sync; try eassumption; apply Hr; assumption)
  end.
  repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  exists r, s; repeat split; eauto with necolus.
Qed.

Lemma ne_related_pair : forall A B e f g h,
    disjoint A B -> ne_related A A e f -> ne_related B B g h ->
    ne_related (styp_and A B) (styp_and A B) (trm_pair e g) (trm_pair f h).
Proof.
  intros A B e f g h Hd H1 H2.
  destruct H1 as (He & Hf & a & a' & Hea & Hfa & Hga & Hga' & Haa).
  destruct H2 as (Hg & Hh & b & b' & Hgb & Hhb & Hgoodb & Hgoodb' & Hbb).
  repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  exists (trm_pair a b), (trm_pair a' b'); repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  - exists a, b; auto.
  - exists a', b'; auto.
  - apply ne_rel_right_pair; simpl; split; auto using ne_disjoint_rel.
    apply ne_rel_sym; eauto using ne_disjoint_rel.
  - apply ne_rel_right_pair; simpl; split; auto using ne_disjoint_rel.
Qed.

Lemma ne_related_rcd : forall A l e f,
    ne_related A A e f ->
    ne_related (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l A) (trm_rcd l e) (trm_rcd l f).
Proof.
  intros A l e f (He & Hf & a & b & Hea & Hfb & Ha & Hb & Hab).
  repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  exists (trm_rcd l a), (trm_rcd l b); repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  - exists a; auto.
  - exists b; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ne_related_proj : forall A l e f,
    ne_related (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l A) e f ->
    ne_related A A (trm_proj e l) (trm_proj f l).
Proof.
  intros A l e f (He & Hf & a & b & Hea & Hfb & (x & -> & Hx) & (y & -> & Hy) & Hxy).
  repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  exists x, y; repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  apply Hxy; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ne_related_cast : forall A B C D c d e f,
    sub A B c -> sub C D d -> ne_related A C e f ->
    ne_related B D (trm_capp c e) (trm_capp d f).
Proof.
  intros A B C D c d e f Hc Hd (He & Hf & a & b & Hea & Hfb & Hga & Hgb & Hab).
  destruct (ne_sub_transport _ _ _ Hc _ Hga) as (x & Hax & Hgx & Hrx).
  destruct (ne_sub_transport _ _ _ Hd _ Hgb) as (y & Hby & Hgy & Hry).
  repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  exists x, y; repeat split; eauto with necolus.
  apply ne_rel_sym, Hry; auto. apply ne_rel_sym, Hrx; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ne_related_abs : forall A B e f,
    lc_exp (trm_abs e) -> lc_exp (trm_abs f) ->
    (forall a, ne_good A a ->
      ne_eval (ne_good B) (e "'^''^ a) /'"\\ ne_eval (ne_good B) (f "'^''^ a)) ->
    (forall a b, ne_good A a -> ne_good A b -> ne_rel A A a b ->
      ne_related B B (e ''^''^ a) (f ''^''^ b)) ->
    ne_related (styp_arrow A B) (styp_arrow A B) (trm_abs e) (trm_abs f).
Proof.
  intros A B e f He Hf Hunary Hbinary.
  repeat split; auto.
  exists (trm_abs e), (trm_abs f); split; [constructor |]; split; [constructor |].
  split; [| split].
  - split; eauto with necolus.
    intros a Ha; destruct (Hunary _ Ha) as [(r & Hr & Hgr) _].
    exists r; eauto with necolus.
  - split; eauto with necolus.
    intros a Ha; destruct (Hunary _ Ha) as [_ (r & Hr & Hgr)].
    exists r; eauto with necolus.
  - intros a b Ha Hb Hab.
    destruct (Hbinary _ _ Ha Hb Hab) as (_ & _ & r & s & Hr & Hs & Hgr & Hgs & Hrs).
    exists r, s; repeat split; eauto with necolus.
Qed.

Lemma ne_degree_weaken : forall k e, degree_exp_wrt_exp k e ->
    forall n, k <= n -> degree_exp_wrt_exp n e.
Proof. induction 1; intros n Hle; constructor; eauto; try lia. Qed.

Local Ltac ne_open_index :=
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec _ _) as [[? | ?] | ?]; simpl in *.

Lemma ne_degree_open_id : forall k e, degree_exp_wrt_exp k e ->
    forall u, open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k u e = e.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros; simpl; try (f_equal; auto).
  ne_open_index; try reflexivity; lia.
Qed.

Lemma ne_degree_open : forall e k u, degree_exp_wrt_exp (S k) e ->
    degree_exp_wrt_exp 0 u -> degree_exp_wrt_exp k (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k u e).
Proof.
  induction e; intros k u He Hu; inversion He; subst; simpl;
    try solve [constructor; eauto].
  ne_open_index.
  - constructor; lia.
  - eapply ne_degree_weaken; [exact Hu | lia].
  - lia.
Qed.

Lemma ne_degree_open_inv : forall e k x,
    degree_exp_wrt_exp k (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k (trm_var_f x) e) ->
    degree_exp_wrt_exp (S k) e.
Proof.
  induction e; intros k x H; simpl in *; try solve [inversion H; constructor; eauto].
  ne_open_index; constructor; try lia; inversion H; lia.
Qed.

Lemma ne_degree_close : forall e k x, degree_exp_wrt_exp k e ->
    degree_exp_wrt_exp (S k) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k x e).
Proof.
  induction e; intros k x H; inversion H; subst; simpl;
    try solve [constructor; eauto].
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec n k); constructor; lia.
  - destruct (x == x0); constructor; lia.
Qed.

Lemma ne_size_open_var : forall e k x,
    size_exp (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k (trm_var_f x) e) = size_exp e.
Proof.
  induction e; intros; simpl; repeat rewrite IHe || rewrite IHe1 || rewrite IHe2;
    try reflexivity.
  ne_open_index; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ne_degree_lc : forall e, degree_exp_wrt_exp 0 e -> lc_exp e.
Proof.
  induction e using (well_founded_induction (well_founded_ltof exp size_exp)).
  intros He; inversion He; subst; try solve [constructor; eauto; apply H; [unfold ltof; simpl; lia | assumption]].
  - lia.
  - constructor; intro x.
    apply H.
    + unfold ltof, open_exp_wrt_exp; rewrite ne_size_open_var; simpl; lia.
    + apply ne_degree_open; eauto with necolus.
Qed.

Lemma ne_lc_degree : forall e, lc_exp e -> degree_exp_wrt_exp 0 e.
Proof.
  induction 1; try solve [constructor; auto].
  constructor. eapply ne_degree_open_inv; eauto using atom_fresh_for_list.
Qed.

Local Hint Resolve ne_degree_lc ne_lc_degree : necolus.

cat >> Task.v <<'EOF'

Definition ne_assignment := var -> exp.

Definition ne_update (rho : ne_assignment) x a : ne_assignment :=
  fun y => if x == y then a else rho y.

Fixpoint ne_instantiate (rho : ne_assignment) (e : exp) : exp :=
  match e with
  | trm_var_f x => rho x
  | trm_abs b => trm_abs (ne_instantiate rho b)
  | trm_app f a => trm_app (ne_instantiate rho f) (ne_instantiate rho a)
  | trm_pair a b => trm_pair (ne_instantiate rho a) (ne_instantiate rho b)
  | trm_rcd l a => trm_rcd l (ne_instantiate rho a)
  | trm_proj a l => trm_proj (ne_instantiate rho a) l
  | trm_capp c a => trm_capp c (ne_instantiate rho a)
  | _ => e
  end.

Definition ne_scoped (rho : ne_assignment) :=
  forall x, degree_exp_wrt_exp 0 (rho x).

Lemma ne_instantiate_degree : forall e k rho, ne_scoped rho ->
    degree_exp_wrt_exp k e -> degree_exp_wrt_exp k (ne_instantiate rho e).
Proof.
  intros e k rho Hr H; induction H; simpl; try solve [constructor; auto].
  eapply ne_degree_weaken; [apply Hr | lia].
Qed.

Lemma ne_instantiate_lc : forall e rho, ne_scoped rho ->
    lc_exp e -> lc_exp (ne_instantiate rho e).
Proof. eauto using ne_degree_lc, ne_instantiate_degree, ne_lc_degree. Qed.

Lemma ne_update_hit : forall rho x a, ne_update rho x a x = a.
Proof. intros; unfold ne_update; destruct (x == x); congruence. Qed.

Lemma ne_update_miss : forall rho x y a, x <> y -> ne_update rho x a y = rho y.
Proof. intros; unfold ne_update; destruct (x == y); congruence. Qed.

Lemma ne_scoped_update : forall rho x a,
    ne_scoped rho -> lc_exp a -> ne_scoped (ne_update rho x a).
Proof.
  unfold ne_scoped, ne_update; intros; destruct (x == x0); eauto with necolus.
Qed.

Lemma ne_instantiate_open : forall e k rho x a,
    ne_scoped rho -> x \\notin fv_exp e ->
    ne_instantiate (ne_update rho x a) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k (trm_var_f x) e)
    = open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k a (ne_instantiate rho e).
Proof.
  induction e; intros k rho z a Hr Hz; simpl in *;
    try solve [f_equal; eauto; try (apply IHe1 || apply IHe2); auto; fsetdec].
  - ne_open_index; auto using ne_update_hit.
  - rewrite ne_update_miss by fsetdec.
    symmetry; apply ne_degree_open_id, ne_degree_weaken with (k := 0); auto with arith.
Qed.

Lemma ne_instantiate_close : forall e k rho x a, ne_scoped rho ->
    ne_instantiate (ne_update rho x a) e =
    open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k a (ne_instantiate rho (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k x e)).
Proof.
  induction e; intros k rho z a Hr; simpl;
    try solve [f_equal; eauto].
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec n k); simpl; ne_open_index; try reflexivity; try lia.
    f_equal; lia.
  - destruct (z == x) as [E | E]; subst; simpl.
    + rewrite ne_update_hit. ne_open_index; auto; lia.
    + rewrite ne_update_miss by assumption.
      symmetry; apply ne_degree_open_id, ne_degree_weaken with (k := 0); auto with arith.
Qed.

Lemma ne_instantiate_id : forall e, ne_instantiate trm_var_f e = e.
Proof. induction e; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ne_source_degree : forall G E d A e, has_type G E d A e ->
    degree_exp_wrt_exp 0 e.
Proof.
  induction 1; eauto with necolus.
  pick fresh x for L.
  constructor. eapply ne_degree_open_inv; eauto.
Qed.

Definition ne_good_env (G : sctx) rho :=
  ne_scoped rho /\\ forall x A, binds x A G -> ne_good A (rho x).

Definition ne_rel_env (G : sctx) rho sigma :=
  ne_good_env G rho /\\ ne_good_env G sigma /\\
  forall x A, binds x A G -> ne_rel A A (rho x) (sigma x).

Lemma ne_binds_cons : forall (G : sctx) x y A B,
    binds y B ((x ~ A) ++ G) ->
    (y = x /\\ B = A) \\/ binds y B G.
Proof.
  unfold binds; simpl; intros G x y A B [H | H]; [left; congruence | auto].
Qed.

Lemma ne_good_env_update : forall G rho x A a,
    x \\notin dom G -> ne_good_env G rho -> ne_good A a ->
    ne_good_env ((x ~ A) ++ G) (ne_update rho x a).
Proof.
  intros G rho x A a Hfresh [Hs HG] Ha.
  split; [eapply ne_scoped_update; eauto with necolus |].
  intros y B Hy. apply ne_binds_cons in Hy.
  destruct Hy as [[-> ->] | Hy].
  - rewrite ne_update_hit; assumption.
  - rewrite ne_update_miss; auto.

Lemma ne_inferred_type : forall G E A B e f,
    has_type G E Inf A e -> has_type G E Inf B f -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros G E A B e f H.
  remember Inf as d eqn:Hd; revert B f Hd.
  induction H; intros T t Hd Ht; subst;
    try discriminate; inversion Ht; subst; try reflexivity;
    try solve [eapply binds_unique; eauto];
    repeat match goal with
    | IH : forall (B : styp) (f : exp), Inf = Inf -> has_type _ ?E Inf B f -> _,
      Hother : has_type _ ?E Inf _ _ |- _ =>
        let Eqt := fresh \"Htype\" in
        pose proof (IH _ _ eq_refl Hother) as Eqt;
        clear IH
    end; congruence.
Qed.

    | H1 : has_type _ ee1 Inf ?B1 ?f1, H2 : has_type _ ee2 Inf ?B2 ?f2 |- _ =>
